name: pivot-web-search
description: A resilient, multi-provider web search and content extraction plugin for Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock and other API providers.

enabled_providers.title: Search providers
enabled_providers.description: Comma-separated providers in failover order: ddg, tavily, brave, gemini, searxng. Default: ddg,tavily,brave,gemini

proxy_urls.title: Proxy URLs
proxy_urls.description: Comma-separated proxy URLs in priority order. Use 'direct' for no proxy. Default: direct

gemini_daily_quota.title: Gemini daily quota
gemini_daily_quota.description: Daily grounded search limit (resets at PT midnight). Check your limit at https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit. Leave empty for no limit.
